whyMatters.en: London band whose early singles pioneered distorted power-chord rock; You Really Got Me (1964) is a hard-rock / garage root citation.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦乐队：早期单曲开创失真强力和弦摇滚；You Really Got Me（1964）是 hard-rock / garage 根源引用。

shortBio.en: Davies brothers rock’n’roll; You Really Got Me is the riff prototype.
shortBio.zh: Davies 兄弟的摇滚；You Really Got Me 是 riff 原型。

body.en:
Formed 1963. Mid-1960s Pye singles (You Really Got Me, All Day and All of the Night) used sliced-speaker distortion and Ray Davies’s songwriting; later Village Green–era work turned toward English observational pop.

You Really Got Me (1964) is the essential track here—two-chord riff, Dave Davies’s guitar grind. Cited by Van Halen and countless garage/hard-rock bands as a distortion template.
body.zh:
1963 年组建。1960 年代中期 Pye 单曲（You Really Got Me、All Day and All of the Night）使用划破扬声器的失真与 Ray Davies 写作；后期 Village Green 时期转向英式观察流行。

You Really Got Me（1964）是此处必听——两和弦 riff、Dave Davies 的吉他碾磨。被 Van Halen 与大量 garage/hard-rock 乐队引为失真模板。
